cjpm.toml.text:
[dependencies]
  [dependencies.bgfx4cj]
    git = "https://gitcode.com/Cangjie-TPC/bgfx4cj.git"
    output-type = "static"
  [dependencies.openalsoft4cj]
    git = "https://gitcode.com/yq24w/openalsoft4cj.git"
    output-type = "static"
  [dependencies.jolt4cj]
    git = "https://gitcode.com/yq24w/jolt4cj.git"
    output-type = "static"
  [dependencies.luajit4cj]
    git = "https://gitcode.com/yq24w/luajit4cj.git"
    output-type = "static"
  [dependencies.httpclient4cj]
    git = "https://gitcode.com/yq24w/httpclient4cj.git"
    branch = "httpclient4cj_cangjie-1.1.0"
    output-type = "static"
  [dependencies.fastjson]
    git = "https://gitcode.com/yq24w/cjfast_json.git"
    output-type = "static"
  [dependencies.sdl4cj]
    git = "https://gitcode.com/yq24w/sdl4cj.git"
    output-type = "static"
  [dependencies.imgui4cj]
    git = "https://gitcode.com/yq24w/imgui4cj.git"
    output-type = "static"

[package]
  cjc-version = "1.1.0"
  compile-option = "-Woff unused"
  description = "three"
  link-option = "-L ${EXTEDN_LIBS_PATH} ${EXTEDN_LINK_OPTION}"
  name = "three"
  output-type = "dynamic"
  override-compile-option = ""
  src-dir = "src"
  target-dir = ""
  version = "0.0.372"
  [package.package-configuration]

[profile]
  [profile.build]
    incremental = true
    lto = ""
    #[profile.build.combined]
    #  three = "dynamic"
  [profile.customized-option]
    debug = "-g -Woff all -Won apilevel-check"
    release = "--fast-math -O2 -s -Woff all -Won apilevel-check"
  [profile.test]

[target]
  # ---- Windows (MinGW) ----
  [target.x86_64-w64-mingw32]
    link-option = "@${EXTEDN_LIBS_PATH}/exclude.rsp -l:libimgui.a -l:libSDL3.a -l:libbimg_capi.a -l:libbimg_decode.a -l:libbimg_encode.a -l:libgeometryc_capi.a -l:libshaderc_capi.a -l:libbgfx.a -l:libbimg.a -l:libbx.a -l:libOpenAL32.a -l:libminiaudio.a -l:libjoltc.a -l:libJolt.a -l:libluajit.a -l:libtlsbridge.a -l:libssl.a -l:libcrypto.a -l:libcommon.a -l:libdefault.a -l:libstdc++.a -l:libgcc_eh.a -lhid -luser32 -lgdi32 -lwinmm -limm32 -lole32 -loleaut32 -lversion -luuid -lsetupapi -lshell32 -ldinput8 -ld3d11 -ldxgi -ld3dcompiler -lavrt -ldsound -lws2_32 -lcrypt32 -ladvapi32 -lz"
  [target.aarch64-w64-mingw32]
    link-option = "@${EXTEDN_LIBS_PATH}/exclude.rsp -l:libimgui.a -l:libSDL3.a -l:libbimg_capi.a -l:libbimg_decode.a -l:libbimg_encode.a -l:libgeometryc_capi.a -l:libshaderc_capi.a -l:libbgfx.a -l:libbimg.a -l:libbx.a -l:libOpenAL32.a -l:libminiaudio.a -l:libjoltc.a -l:libJolt.a -l:libluajit.a -l:libtlsbridge.a -l:libssl.a -l:libcrypto.a -l:libcommon.a -l:libdefault.a -l:libstdc++.a -l:libgcc_eh.a -lhid -luser32 -lgdi32 -lwinmm -limm32 -lole32 -loleaut32 -lversion -luuid -lsetupapi -lshell32 -ldinput8 -ld3d11 -ldxgi -ld3dcompiler -lavrt -ldsound -lws2_32 -lcrypt32 -ladvapi32 -lz"
  # ---- Linux ----
  [target.x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu]
    link-option = "--version-script=${EXTEDN_LIBS_PATH}/symbols_elf.map -l:libimgui.a -l:libSDL3.a -l:libbimg_capi.a -l:libbimg_decode.a -l:libbimg_encode.a -l:libgeometryc_capi.a -l:libshaderc_capi.a -l:libbgfx.a -l:libbimg.a -l:libbx.a -l:libopenal.a -l:libminiaudio.a -l:libjoltc.a -l:libJolt.a -l:libluajit.a -l:libtlsbridge.a -l:libssl.a -l:libcrypto.a -l:libcommon.a -l:libdefault.a -l:libstdc++.a -l:libgcc_eh.a -lX11 -lXext -lXcursor -lXi -lXfixes -lXrandr -lXrender -lGL -lasound -lstdc++ -lpthread -ldl -lrt -lm"
  [target.aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu]
    link-option = "--version-script=${EXTEDN_LIBS_PATH}/symbols_elf.map -l:libimgui.a -l:libSDL3.a -l:libbimg_capi.a -l:libbimg_decode.a -l:libbimg_encode.a -l:libgeometryc_capi.a -l:libshaderc_capi.a -l:libbgfx.a -l:libbimg.a -l:libbx.a -l:libopenal.a -l:libminiaudio.a -l:libjoltc.a -l:libJolt.a -l:libluajit.a -l:libtlsbridge.a -l:libssl.a -l:libcrypto.a -l:libcommon.a -l:libdefault.a -l:libstdc++.a -l:libgcc_eh.a -lX11 -lXext -lXcursor -lXi -lXfixes -lXrandr -lXrender -lGL -lasound -lstdc++ -lpthread -ldl -lrt -lm"
  # ---- macOS ----
  [target.x86_64-apple-darwin]
    link-option = "-l:libimgui.a -l:libSDL3.a -l:libbimg_capi.a -l:libbimg_decode.a -l:libbimg_encode.a -l:libgeometryc_capi.a -l:libshaderc_capi.a -l:libbgfx.a -l:libbimg.a -l:libbx.a -l:libopenal.a -l:libminiaudio.a -l:libjoltc.a -l:libJolt.a -l:libluajit.a -l:libtlsbridge.a -l:libssl.a -l:libcrypto.a -l:libcommon.a -l:libdefault.a -lc++ -framework Cocoa -framework IOKit -framework CoreVideo -framework CoreFoundation -framework OpenGL -framework CoreAudio -framework AudioToolbox -framework AudioUnit"
  [target.aarch64-apple-darwin]
    link-option = "-l:libimgui.a -l:libSDL3.a -l:libbimg_capi.a -l:libbimg_decode.a -l:libbimg_encode.a -l:libgeometryc_capi.a -l:libshaderc_capi.a -l:libbgfx.a -l:libbimg.a -l:libbx.a -l:libopenal.a -l:libminiaudio.a -l:libjoltc.a -l:libJolt.a -l:libluajit.a -l:libtlsbridge.a -l:libssl.a -l:libcrypto.a -l:libcommon.a -l:libdefault.a -lc++ -framework Cocoa -framework IOKit -framework CoreVideo -framework CoreFoundation -framework OpenGL -framework CoreAudio -framework AudioToolbox -framework AudioUnit"
  # ---- OpenHarmony (OHOS) ----
  [target.aarch64-linux-ohos]
    compile-option = "-B \"${DEVECO_CANGJIE_HOME}/build-tools/third_party/llvm/bin\" -B \"${DEVECO_OH_NATIVE_HOME}/sysroot/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-ohos\" -L \"${DEVECO_OH_NATIVE_HOME}/sysroot/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-ohos\" -L \"${DEVECO_OH_NATIVE_HOME}/llvm/lib/clang/15.0.4/lib/aarch64-linux-ohos\" -L \"${DEVECO_OH_NATIVE_HOME}/llvm/lib/aarch64-linux-ohos\" --sysroot \"${DEVECO_OH_NATIVE_HOME}/sysroot\""
    link-option = "--version-script=${EXTEDN_LIBS_PATH}/symbols_elf.map -l:libimgui.a -l:libbimg_capi.a -l:libbimg_decode.a -l:libbimg_encode.a -l:libgeometryc_capi.a -l:libshaderc_capi.a -l:libbgfx.a -l:libbimg.a -l:libbx.a -lSDL3 -lEGL -lGLESv3 -l:libopenal.a -l:libminiaudio.a -l:libjoltc.a -l:libJolt.a -l:libluajit.a -l:libtlsbridge.a -l:libssl.a -l:libcrypto.a -l:libcommon.a -l:libdefault.a -lohsensor -lhilog_ndk.z -lace_ndk.z -lrawfile.z -lace_napi.z -l:libc++_static.a -l:libc++abi.a -l:libunwind.a -lpthread -ldl -l:libnative_window.so"
  [target.x86_64-linux-ohos]
    compile-option = "-B \"${DEVECO_CANGJIE_HOME}/build-tools/third_party/llvm/bin\" -B \"${DEVECO_OH_NATIVE_HOME}/sysroot/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-ohos\" -L \"${DEVECO_OH_NATIVE_HOME}/sysroot/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-ohos\" -L \"${DEVECO_OH_NATIVE_HOME}/llvm/lib/clang/15.0.4/lib/x86_64-linux-ohos\" -L \"${DEVECO_OH_NATIVE_HOME}/llvm/lib/x86_64-linux-ohos\" --sysroot \"${DEVECO_OH_NATIVE_HOME}/sysroot\""
    link-option = "--version-script=${EXTEDN_LIBS_PATH}/symbols_elf.map -l:libimgui.a -l:libbimg_capi.a -l:libbimg_decode.a -l:libbimg_encode.a -l:libgeometryc_capi.a -l:libshaderc_capi.a -l:libbgfx.a -l:libbimg.a -l:libbx.a -lSDL3 -lEGL -lGLESv3 -l:libopenal.a -l:libminiaudio.a -l:libjoltc.a -l:libJolt.a -l:libluajit.a -l:libtlsbridge.a -l:libssl.a -l:libcrypto.a -l:libcommon.a -l:libdefault.a -lohsensor -lhilog_ndk.z -lace_ndk.z -lrawfile.z -lace_napi.z -l:libc++_static.a -l:libc++abi.a -l:libunwind.a -lpthread -ldl"
